title: Great non-stick baking pans!
text: Great non-stick baking pans!. I love all of Reynolds products, and the new bakeware pans are no exception. Perfect size, non-stick (so I don't have to use butter or that scary 'I don't know what is in it' Pam). I made brownies in the first batch and they popped right out. Great fitting lid so I can store and transport easily. No complaints but would love it if they made these in a bigger pack (maybe 6 pans with 3 lids) so it would be more economical and I could reuse lids. Anyway, I will be purchasing more of these for holiday baking use. Kudos Reynolds for another great product!

product_metadata.title: Reynolds Kitchens Aluminum Pans with Lids, Blue, 8x8 Inch, 3 Count
features: DISPOSABLE ALUMINUM PANS—This package contains three Reynolds Kitchens Disposable Cake Pans with Lids, each measuring 8 x 8 inches
WON’T BUCKLE UNDER PRESSURE—These strong and sturdy aluminum baking pans are made to handle the heartiest desserts and meals
SECURE LIDS—Snug-fitting lids included with these foil pans keep your sweets safe and sound in transport, plus make storing leftovers a snap
OVEN-SAFE and NONSTICK—Save your pans from stuck-on food and make clean-up easy with these recyclable, disposable cake pans
ROYAL BLUE EXTERIOR—Make your next celebratory treat extra-special with the festive royal blue exterior of a Reynolds aluminum cake pan with lid
description: Reynolds Foil Dessert Pans with Lids make baking your cakes, brownies and other pastry treats fuss-free and easy to share with others. Each 8 x 8 aluminum cake pan has a nonstick surface that eliminates the need for oil or spray. Just pour the batter in, and slide your cake right out of the pan after cooling. A snug fitting, clear lid is included for each pan and makes transportation and storing leftovers easy. Plus, when the party’s over, cleanup is simple with these recyclable, disposable pans. Whether you're baking a birthday cake for family or whipping up a cobbler for a party, these aluminum baking pans make fast work of the dishes so you can enjoy the festivities
